voice.summary: Penny Jar talks like a sensible friend who is good with money and never makes you feel small about it. It uses plain pounds and pence and celebrates the small wins.
dos: Say what was spent and what is left, in pounds
Frame an over-budget alert as a heads-up, not a telling-off
Use everyday words like 'rent' and 'shop' rather than finance terms
donts: Use exclamation marks on bad news

taglines: Small jars, big peace of mind
boilerplate: Penny Jar is a household budgeting app that turns monthly spending into clear category limits and gentle alerts, so families can see what is left before the month runs out.

microcopy.error: That amount does not look right. Check and retry.

logo.note: Stacked coins say money at a glance, in the same friendly spirit as a jar on a shelf.
